notes.title: Update Notes For Mar 11 (2)
notes.content:
Balance Patch:
The damage increase rate for Dungeon Epics with adding tags has been reduced to 40%.
The damage increase for Mages has been lowered to 35%.

Bug Fixes:
Text errors in some skills have been corrected.
Issues with the application of Relics to some characters have been corrected.

The synergy between the Mage's new abilities and the Dungeon Epics was greater than anticipated, so the numbers have been slightly reduced.

notes.title: Update Notes For Mar 11
notes.content:
Balance Pathced:
The damage increase for Normal Relics has been uniformly increased from 5% to 10%.
The damage increase for Uncommon Relics has been uniformly increased from 10% to 20%.
A feature has been added to Dungeon Epic Relics with added tags that increases the damage of that tagged skill by 80%.
A feature has been added to Mage's Relics that increases the activation probability by 12% when using a spell tag skill.

Bug Fixes:
The application method of Ailment Damage increase that was partially incorrect has been corrected.
The issue where the activation probability of 65% for Puppeteer Relics was being applied to all skills has been corrected.

Text Corrections:
An error in the text of 'Radiance' has been corrected.

Overall, the numerical adjustments have resulted in a downward adjustment of the game difficulty.
This is intended to be addressed with the addition of later end-game content.

Please let us know if there are any bugs!

Thank you.
